CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.ai_spend_today_v1()
 RETURNS TABLE(use text, label text, spent numeric, guard numeric, calls bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with d as (select (date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'UTC') at time zone 'UTC') t),
  s as (
    select 'scholarship_ai' u, coalesce(sum(x.cost_usd), 0) spent, count(*) calls from pipeline.scholarship_ai_extractions x, d where x.at >= d.t
    union all select 'adapter_builder', coalesce(sum(x.cost_usd), 0), count(*) from pipeline.uni_adapter_drafts x, d where x.created_at >= d.t and coalesce(x.cost_usd, 0) > 0
    union all select 'central_ai', coalesce(sum(x.cost_usd), 0), count(*) from pipeline.central_ai_queue x, d where x.created_at >= d.t and coalesce(x.cost_usd, 0) > 0
    union all select 'course_match', coalesce(sum(x.cost_usd), 0), count(*) from pipeline.coverage_ai_match x, d where coalesce(x.decided_at, x.created_at) >= d.t and coalesce(x.cost_usd, 0) > 0
    union all select 'enrich_fields', coalesce(sum(x.cost_usd), 0), count(*) from pipeline.field_enrich_items x, d where x.updated_at >= d.t and coalesce(x.cost_usd, 0) > 0
    union all select 'fee_ai', coalesce(sum(x.cost_usd), 0), count(*) from pipeline.fee_reader_queue x, d where coalesce(x.finished_at, x.created_at) >= d.t and coalesce(x.cost_usd, 0) > 0
    union all select 'entry_matrix', coalesce(sum(x.cost_usd), 0), count(*) from pipeline.entry_matrix_runs x, d where x.updated_at >= d.t and coalesce(x.cost_usd, 0) > 0)
  select s.u, l.label, round(s.spent, 4), (security.toolset_setting('openrouter', 'guard_' || s.u))::text::numeric, s.calls
    from s join (values ('scholarship_ai', 'Read scholarship pages with AI', 1), ('adapter_builder', 'Adapter proposals', 2), ('central_ai', 'Central pages with AI', 3),
                        ('course_match', 'AI course-page matching', 4), ('enrich_fields', 'Enrich fields with AI', 5), ('fee_ai', 'Fee reader with AI', 6), ('entry_matrix', 'Entry matrices with AI', 7)) l(u, label, sort) on l.u = s.u
   order by l.sort
$function$

public.svc_coverage_ai_match_next(intege.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.svc_coverage_ai_match_next(p_limit integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'catalogue', 'pipeline', 'security'
AS $function$
declare v jsonb;
begin
  if current_user <> 'postgres' and coalesce(auth.role(), '') <> 'service_role' then raise exception 'service_role required'; end if;
  with pick as (
    select q.id from pipeline.coverage_ai_match q
      left join pipeline.course_priority cp on cp.course_id = q.course_id
      left join pipeline.provider_priority pp on pp.provider_id = q.provider_id
     where (q.state = 'ready' or (q.state = 'leased' and q.leased_until < now()))
       and not exists (select 1 from security.provider_hidden_v1 h where h.provider_id = q.provider_id)  -- v2.15.237: paused while the provider is unpublished or archived
     order by (q.state = 'leased'), coalesce(cp.sort, 1000000), coalesce(pp.rank, 100000), q.id
     limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 20), 80)) for update of q skip locked),
  upd as (update pipeline.coverage_ai_match q set state = 'leased', leased_until = now() + interval '10 minutes' from pick where q.id = pick.id returning q.*)
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', u.id, 'course_id', u.course_id, 'provider_id', u.provider_id, 'title', co.canonical_title,
           'code', case when co.course_code ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-' then null else co.course_code end,
           'level', (select sl.name from ref.study_levels sl where sl.id = co.study_level_id),
           'provider', coalesce(pr.display_name, pr.canonical_name), 'country', security.coverage_country(u.provider_id),
           'candidates', u.candidates)), '[]'::jsonb)
    into v from upd u join catalogue.courses co on co.id = u.course_id join catalogue.providers pr on pr.id = u.provider_id;
  return v;
end $function$
